method: the qualifier reads the immutable DSH Session header through the OFFICIAL reader (SessionPersistence.open(id,read)) and requires the header SessionId to equal the observed identity
checks: the Session exists and is readable
the header SessionId matches the observed SessionId
an unreadable/unsupported/missing source is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, distinct from a conflict
a header naming a different session is SOURCE_REFUSED
notClaimed: a matching Session Header CWD alone does not prove Attempt ownership — a Session may share a workspace with others
